brief: A short anti-slop lab for TokenMax burn night.

design_system.brief: A short anti-slop lab for TokenMax burn night.

palette.label: Ink night (restrained dark)
palette.why: Dark only when the brief asks; gold accent instead of purple glow.

typography.notes: One grotesk family; hierarchy from size/weight, not a third face.

anti_patterns: No purple-to-blue gradients; accents stay brand-owned.
No Inter/Roboto-by-default; name the faces in DESIGN.md.
No three identical feature cards on marketing surfaces.
Motion explains state change; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Copy states a specific outcome — ban unlock/supercharge/seamless.
Tokens in :root before one-off hex in components.
